usageNotes: Permanently deletes a cluster-level firewall security group. The group must have all its rules removed first — Proxmox will reject the request if the group is non-empty. Requires the Sys.Modify privilege at the root path ('/'), meaning only cluster admins can perform this action.
destructiveReason: Permanently removes the named cluster firewall security group; any firewall rules still referencing this group by name on nodes or VMs will become dangling references.
tips: Use get_cluster_firewall_groups_group (GET /cluster/firewall/groups/{group}) to list existing rules in the group before deletion — the group must be empty.
Security group names are 2–18 characters, must start with a letter, and may only contain letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores.
This operation returns null on success; absence of an error is the confirmation.
If any VM or node firewall rule references this group, those rule entries will silently become invalid after deletion — audit usages with get_cluster_firewall_refs before deleting.
